goal: An operator SIGINT/SIGTERM while the agent is mid-iteration deterministically finalizes the in-flight lifecycle to INTERRUPTED with no stranded `running` state, and the run is resumable.

relevant: src/flywheel/invoker.py — around the `async for msg in source` stream loop (~line 181)
src/flywheel/harness.py — attempt finalization (`_run_attempt`) and the existing `_handle_audit_failure` pattern
.workflow/worker.py — SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handling and the KeyboardInterrupt/CancelledError path around run_once
docs/task-lifecycle.md — INTERRUPTED status and its legal transitions
.workflow/audits/02-harness-resilience.md — the documented stranded-`running` defect this closes
references: src/flywheel/invoker.py:181 — `async for msg in source`, where cancellation must propagate cleanly with the partial iteration_result intact
.workflow/worker.py:668-754 — _arm_signals, shutdown flag handler, KeyboardInterrupt/CancelledError handling around run_once
src/flywheel/harness.py — mirror the existing `_handle_audit_failure` pattern for routing cancellation to finalization
recover_stranded_lifecycles — retained as the backstop for ungraceful termination (SIGKILL/OOM/reboot)
constraints: Finalize the interrupted attempt/lifecycle to INTERRUPTED, never FAILED_VALIDATION.
Perform finalization in-band at the harness attempt boundary; do not rely on the later recovery sweep for the graceful (signal) path.
Keep recover_stranded_lifecycles as the backstop for SIGKILL/OOM/reboot, which no in-process handler can catch.
Preserve messages persisted before the interrupt (live via 00010); do not roll them back.
Emit a telemetry `harness.*` interruption event (e.g. harness.interrupted); introduce no new domain-event kind.
Finalization must be idempotent under a second signal during shutdown: complete once, no crash.
Do not change the schema; INTERRUPTED is an existing status. Keep flywheel.task and flywheel.lifecycle purity untouched.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance errors in the same turn.
Commit with a Conventional Commits `feat:` message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No mid-run steering, message injection, or model change (feature 00013); this is stop-only.
No store-backed control channel; the trigger is an OS signal to the worker, not a stored command.
Do not remove the startup recovery sweep; recover_stranded_lifecycles stays as the ungraceful-kill backstop.
No per-iteration partial grading; an interrupted attempt does not run graders.
Do not change resume mechanics; resume through `ready` already exists and is unchanged.
edge_cases: Signal arrives between iterations (not mid-stream): same outcome, the in-flight lifecycle finalizes INTERRUPTED.
Finalization write fails during interrupt: follow the existing harness.audit_write_failed semantics; never leave the lifecycle silently `running`.
SIGKILL/OOM/reboot is uncatchable: not covered in-band; recover_stranded_lifecycles finalizes on the next orchestrate startup (unchanged backstop).
Second signal during shutdown: idempotent; finalization completes once with no crash.
Interrupt during `validating` (after invoke, before graders): finalize INTERRUPTED; graders do not run.
Concurrent workers, one interrupted: only the interrupted worker's in-flight task is affected; leases free it for reclaim per existing rules.
